notes: Tree: consumable > food / drink / potion / blighted-supply / charge-item; magic > magic-rune / magic-tablet / teleport / magic-orb; prayer > bone / demonic-ash / shade-remains / ensouled-head / pyre-log / prayer-scroll; misc > cannon > cannonball. Potions are grouped potion > purpose (combat-boost, restore, run-energy, cure, dragonfire-protection, skill-boost) > family (super-combat, prayer-potion ...). Each family covers every dose, the barbarian mix and the divine variant, so e.g. "Divine super combat potion(4)" is super-combat + divine-potion. Fish family keys (shark, anglerfish, karambwan, manta-ray, ...) use parent "material" and match raw, cooked, blighted and crate forms by name, so they can be merged with the raw-fish domain's identical keys. The key "magic-rune" (label "Runes") avoids clashing with the metal tier family "rune". teleport sits under magic; charged teleport jewellery (glory, dueling, games ...) also gets the equipment domain's jewellery tags. League/DMM cosmetic "teleport scroll" items are excluded. dragon-bone groups all dragonkin bones (dragon, superior, lava, frost, baby, wyvern, drake, hydra, wyrm) rather than one tag per bone type; it does not reuse the metal "dragon" key on purpose. No heal-amount groupings: the item data has no heal values and wiki categories do not encode them. pyre-log is placed under prayer (Shades of Mort'ton cremation); the woodcutting/firemaking domain may also want it.
